SEARCH
Package org.bremersee.samba.ad.dc.repository.cli.parser

Interface DhcpLeaseParser

All Superinterfaces:
CommandExecutorResponseParser<List<DhcpLease>>
public interface DhcpLeaseParser extends CommandExecutorResponseParser<List<DhcpLease>>
The dhcp lease list parser parses the response of the Linux command line tool dhcp-lease-list.

A response of dhcp-lease-list looks like this: 

 MAC b8:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx IP 192.168.1.109 HOSTNAME ukelei BEGIN 2019-08-18 11:20:33 END 2019-08-18 11:50:33 MANUFACTURER Apple, Inc.
 MAC ac:xx:xx:xx:xx:yy IP 192.168.1.188 HOSTNAME -NA- BEGIN 2019-08-18 11:25:48 END 2019-08-18 11:55:48 MANUFACTURER
Author:
Christian Bremer

    • defaultParser

      static DhcpLeaseParser defaultParser(BinaryOperator<String> unknownHostConverter)
      Default parser dhcp leases parser.

      The unknown host converter converts the unknown host name HOSTNAME_UNKNOWN into another host name. The parameters of the function are MAC and IP.

      Parameters:
      unknownHostConverter - the unknown host converter; first parameter is mac, second is ip
      Returns:
      the dhcp leases parser
